summary_md:
# Ekonomisk D-dag – Sandvik köpstämplas

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode covers the US announcement of 'economic D-Day' sanctions on Iran, oil near $93 with a supply deficit, and the US–Canada tariff war. The main theme is commodities: gold, silver and copper are rallying on sovereign-debt worries, electrification and data-center demand. Guest commentator Christian Kopfer is strongly bullish on SSAB and Boliden. AQ Group CEO James Ahlgren describes strong demand from defense, electrification and data centers, and both guests are constructive on equities over the long term.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SSAB-B — SSAB | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest Kopfer expects new record highs (~108 SEK) and a doubling of market cap to 200bn SEK in ~3 years via earnings and rerating; likes it on 12 months too.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Christian Kopfer). Canada tariff impact is less relevant for SSAB's heavy/special plate, which is made in the US and is defense-critical. Special steel sells out at Oxelösund, which supports price increases. A multi-year rerating is expected. AQ CEO also bullish on specialty steel from defense spending.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US-Canada tariff escalation hits heavy plate more than expected
- if special steel demand/pricing weakens
- if rerating fails to materialise

> *"Jag tror ju att SSAB kan vara värt 200 miljarder om, vad ska vi säga nu är det 2027 snart så 3 år bort kanske drygt."*

---

### 🟢 BOL — Boliden | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Kopfer sees Boliden as best positioned; operational normalisation gives exceptional organic profit growth (~40% in 2 years); gold supercycle tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Gold is in a supercycle driven by sovereign-debt worries and central-bank buying, and copper benefits from electrification. Undemanding multiples mean share price should track profit growth. The main risk is a proposed ~20bn Peru/Brazil acquisition, which could need ~10bn of new equity and heavy capex.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Boliden completes the Peru/Brazil acquisition with a large equity raise
- if operational disruptions persist
- if gold/copper prices reverse on rate hikes

> *"Hur orolig man än är för världen, eller om man är orolig för världen så landar det i ett köp på Boliden."*

---

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Broker (SEB, transcribed 'SCB') upgraded to buy on mining equipment. Kopfer notes heavy underground copper/gold exposure.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst upgrade plus guest agreement: mining-equipment suppliers ride the gold/copper rally. Exposure is weighted toward underground copper and gold mining, which look strong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices fall
- if mining capex slows

> *"Där har SCB höjt till en köpstämpel för gruvutrustning."*

---

### 🟢 SAGA-B — Sagax | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Danske Bank initiated coverage with a buy; stock among top gainers at the open.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only; no host view beyond reporting the initiation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise further

> *"Sagax är också i topp, efter att Danske Bank initierat sin bevakning på bolaget."*

---

### 🟠 NIBE-B — Nibe | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Strong report well received; analysts raised targets slightly; electrification should benefit; host: 'maybe the stock continues up a bit'.

#### Reasoning

Host/reporter view (Martin Bunge) is tentatively positive after a weak long-term chart. Analysts raised price targets modestly, and heat pumps benefit from the move away from oil and gas.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report-driven recovery fades
- if heat pump demand weakens

> *"Så kanske fortsätter den här aktien upp lite."*

---

### 🟠 EPI-A — Epiroc | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Mining-equipment supplier performing well on the metals rally; underground copper/gold exposure.

#### Reasoning

Host and guest view Epiroc as a beneficiary of rising gold/copper prices, but gave no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices reverse

> *"Om jag minns rätt så är exponeringen i Sandvik och Epiroc väldigt tung mot underjord. kopparguld."*

---

### 🟠 EPIS-B — Episurf | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Aggressive convertible-financed property expansion; wind-down of medtech business read as a failure.

#### Reasoning

Host interprets the switch from a sale/spin-off to a wind-down as a failure. Funding property deals with convertibles adds dilution risk. Host said it will be interesting to see how the report is received.

#### Sell Triggers

- if convertible dilution accelerates

> *"Så jag tolkar det lite som ett misslyckande att man nu bara vill bli av med det här och sänka kostnaderna."*

---

### 🟠 AQ — AQ Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

CEO sees steep demand from data centers, defense and electrification; capacity built ahead of customers; high valuation noted.

#### Reasoning

Company-insider (CEO) opinion, not independent. Structural growth comes from defense and electrification, and commodity costs are passed through to customers. The high valuation raises the bar for delivery.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth fails to justify the premium valuation
- if defense customers' ramp-up is delayed

> *"Den är väl brant, skulle jag säga."*

---
